Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Plus Review: Is this the best Android tablet of 2026? In this Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Plus full review, we test the display, gaming performance, battery life, multitasking and daily usage to find out if this premium Samsung tablet is worth buying.
The Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Plus comes with a 12.6-inch AMOLED display with up to a 144Hz refresh rate, Dimensity 9500 processor, 12GB RAM, 512GB UFS 4.0 storage and a massive 10,600mAh battery.
